title: [YSQL][Colocation] Tablegroup index crashed with a failed CHECK
body:
Jira Link: [DB-2953](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-2953)
### Description

Using  YB v2.15.0.1-b1 (0208537c663a56ec695ec1dbdd9a504c5bc74ad2):
```sql
CREATE TABLEGROUP tg;
CREATE TABLE tbl (a int) TABLEGROUP tg;
CREATE INDEX ON tbl (a);
-- Restart yb-tserver
DROP INDEX tbl_a_idx;;
-- WARNING:  Network error: recvmsg got EOF from remote
```
